## What is a Claude watermark remover?

A Claude watermark remover is a free text cleaner that strips invisible and non-standard Unicode characters out of AI-generated writing. It removes zero-width spaces, word joiners, bidirectional controls, variation selectors and Unicode tag characters, then converts unusual spaces and smart punctuation into plain ASCII.

Anthropic has not published any text watermarking system for Claude, so there is no confirmed hidden signature to find. What people call a “Claude watermark” is normal Unicode that survives a copy and paste: narrow no-break spaces, non-breaking spaces, curly quotes and em dashes. This tool removes exactly those characters, which fixes broken code, failed CSV imports and inconsistent formatting. [...] ### Does Claude put a watermark in its text? ▼

Anthropic has not published any text watermarking system for Claude, so there is no confirmed hidden signature in Claude output. What people call a Claude watermark is usually ordinary Unicode: narrow no-break spaces, non-breaking spaces, curly quotes and em dashes that survive a copy and paste. This tool removes those characters.

### What is a Claude watermark remover? ▼

A Claude watermark remover is a text cleaner that strips invisible and non-standard Unicode characters out of AI-generated writing. It removes zero-width spaces, word joiners, bidirectional controls, variation selectors and Unicode tag characters, and it can normalise unusual spaces and smart punctuation to plain ASCII. [...] ### Safe defaults for other scripts

Joiners and bidirectional marks carry real meaning in Arabic, Hebrew and emoji sequences. Each category has its own switch, so you can leave those alone.

### Free with no limits

No account, no daily quota, no paid tier. There is no word count ceiling either, because the work happens on your own machine.

Advertisement

## Quick answer

 Claude does not have a confirmed text watermark. Anthropic has never published one.
 The characters people find are ordinary Unicode: `U+00A0`, `U+202F`, curly quotes and em dashes.
 Removing them fixes broken code, failed imports and messy formatting.
 It does not change what an AI detector sees, because detectors read writing style, not invisible bytes.
 This tool runs in your browser and uploads nothing.
